messages:
eli: FYI starting canary bringup for sorrel21b (quant-int8). seeing intermittent OOMs on coldstart and a small eval quality dip on summarization suite. attaching quick notes.
mona: thanks. numbers?
eli: ran three runs against fp16 baseline. int8 avg latency +12%, p95 +34%, throughput -8%. memory footprint down ~22% but fragmentation seems to spike after sustained load — OOMs at 600s in canary runs. quality: rouge-L down ~1.8 pts on long docs.
raj: any stack traces? GPU OOM or host oom?
eli: gpu OOM. logs show failed allocation in KV cache refill path. stack snippet: ```RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 512MB for kv_cache at model/kernels/kv_cache.cpp:243```
katie: hmm sounds like KV eviction not kicking in early. what's batch config?
eli: default batch config for this canary: max_batch_size=16, max_new_tokens=512, prefetch=true, slot_reserve=0.1.
zach: max_new_tokens=512 is high for sorrel. many summon long outputs in tests, that + continuous batching increases KV working set. Suggest lowering default to 256 for this model, and temporary microbatch cap 8.
mona: agree on reducing max_new_tokens. also try increasing slot_reserve and adjust eviction threshold from 0.6->0.45 so eviction is more aggressive.
raj: on quant side, did you use symmetric per-tensor int8 or per-channel? per-channel often retains quality but hurts perf a bit.
eli: we used symmetric per-tensor fast quant (native int8). perf was slightly better but quality hit visible. can try per-channel or hybrid int6 for attention layers.
katie: propose plan: 1) change model defaults: max_new_tokens=256, max_batch_size=12; 2) slot_reserve=0.18, eviction_threshold=0.45; 3) re-run canary with per-channel int8 and hybrid int6 (attention only) variants; 4) run full summarization eval + latency/throughput bench; 5) monitor mem fragmentation with slab metrics.
mona: +1. add automated regression check in CI to fail canary if rouge-L drops >1 pt or p95 increases >25%.
zach: I'll spin infra changes: patch runtime config for this model in model-catalog under sorrel21b/canary/config.json. config snippet: ```{
  "defaults": {
    "max_new_tokens": 256,
    "max_batch_size": 12,
    "slot_reserve": 0.18,
    "eviction_threshold": 0.45
  }
}```
raj: good. for quant experiments, label variants: sorrel21b-int8-perchannel, sorrel21b-hybrid-int6-attn. keep FP16 as control.
eli: running first round now. pushing logs to #eng-ml-artifacts/SORREL-6142. CC @infra-bot to trigger canary gating.
infra-bot: Canary deployment triggered: sorrel21b-int8-perchannel -> 6 instances. Monitoring enabled.
katie: while canary runs, try a targeted eval on long-doc summarization and a short-answer QA set to detect regressions that affect converssational quality.
mona: also add a memory-defrag job after 300s of sustained load to force compaction and see if that prevents OOMs.
zach: added scheduled slot compaction at 300s in canary config.
eli: first canary pass: int8-perchannel latency diff vs fp16: +9% avg, +20% p95. throughput -4%. rouge-L drop 0.7 pts. no OOMs in 20m run.
raj: promising. how about hybrid int6?
eli: hybrid int6-attn run shows +6% avg latency, p95 +18%, throughput -2%, rouge-L drop 0.4 pts. memory stable.
katie: sounds like hybrid is the sweet spot. propose we ship hybrid-int6-attn as default quant variant for sorrel21b and keep perchannel as fallback for stricter quality-sensitive routes.
mona: agree. action items: zach to patch model-catalog defaults + compaction schedule; infra-bot to add CI regression gate; eli to write short postmortem/notes for onboarding doc about these defaults and known tradeoffs; raj to start a follow-up to test mixed precision kernels impact on p95.
zach: patch submitted: PR #7892. will monitor next 24h.
eli: thanks all. will update thread with final go/no-go after 24h canary. :thumbsup:
